label: Referrals received
help: Number of referrals received in the quarter.

label: People starting treatment
help: Number of referrals that had their first treatment appointment in the quarter.

label: Referrals ended
help: Number of referrals that ended in the quarter for any reason.

label: Ended after one treatment appointment
help: Referrals that ended having had only one treatment appointment.

label: Finished a course of treatment
help: Referrals that ended having had two or more treatment appointments.

label: Had a second treatment appointment
help: Referrals that had a second treatment appointment in the quarter.

label: Average appointments per finished course
help: Mean number of treatment appointments for people who finished a course of treatment.

label: Long-term condition appointments (%)
help: Percentage of appointments recorded as long-term condition (LTC) appointments.

label: Long-term condition appointments among people who finished (%)
help: Percentage of appointments that were LTC appointments for people who finished a course of treatment.

label: Average contact time for internet-enabled therapy (minutes)
help: Mean clinician contact time for referrals using internet-enabled therapy (IET).

label: Median wait for first treatment (days)
help: Median days from referral to first treatment appointment for people starting treatment.

label: Median wait for first treatment among people who finished (days)
help: Median days from referral to first treatment for people who finished a course of treatment.

label: Started treatment within 6 weeks (%)
help: Percentage of people finishing treatment who waited 6 weeks or less for their first appointment. National standard: 75%.

label: Started treatment within 6 weeks (number)
help: Number of people finishing treatment who waited 6 weeks or less for their first appointment.

label: Started treatment within 18 weeks (%)
help: Percentage of people finishing treatment who waited 18 weeks or less for their first appointment. National standard: 95%.

label: Started treatment within 18 weeks (number)
help: Number of people finishing treatment who waited 18 weeks or less for their first appointment.

label: Waited over 90 days between 1st and 2nd appointment (%)
help: Percentage of people whose second treatment appointment was more than 90 days after their first.

label: Waited over 28 days between 1st and 2nd appointment (number)
help: Number of people whose second treatment appointment was more than 28 days after their first.

label: Waited over 90 days between 1st and 2nd appointment (number)
help: Number of people whose second treatment appointment was more than 90 days after their first.

label: Average wait from assessment to high-intensity therapy (days)
help: Mean days from assessment to first high-intensity treatment appointment.

label: Average wait from assessment to low-intensity therapy (days)
help: Mean days from assessment to first low-intensity treatment appointment.

label: Average wait when stepping down to low intensity (days)
help: Mean days from last high-intensity to first low-intensity appointment.

label: Average wait when stepping up to high intensity (days)
help: Mean days from last low-intensity to first high-intensity appointment.

label: People assessed then starting high-intensity therapy
help: Number of people behind the high-intensity wait figure.

label: People assessed then starting low-intensity therapy
help: Number of people behind the low-intensity wait figure.

label: People stepped down to low intensity
help: Number of people who moved from high-intensity to low-intensity therapy.

label: People stepped up to high intensity
help: Number of people who moved from low-intensity to high-intensity therapy.

label: Recovery rate (%)
help: Percentage of people who finished treatment (and had symptoms above the clinical threshold at the start) who moved below the threshold by the end. National standard: 50%.

label: Reliable recovery rate (%)
help: Percentage of people who recovered AND whose symptoms improved by more than the measurement error.

label: Reliable improvement rate (%)
help: Percentage of people finishing treatment whose symptoms improved by more than the measurement error.

label: Reliable deterioration rate (%)
help: Percentage of people finishing treatment whose symptoms got worse by more than the measurement error.

label: People who recovered
help: Number of people who moved from above to below the clinical threshold.

label: People who reliably recovered
help: Number of people who recovered and reliably improved.

label: People who reliably improved
help: Number of people whose symptoms improved by more than the measurement error.

label: People with no reliable change
help: Number of people whose symptoms did not change by more than the measurement error.

label: People who reliably deteriorated
help: Number of people whose symptoms got worse by more than the measurement error.

label: Below clinical threshold at start
help: Number of people who finished treatment but were not above the clinical threshold (caseness) at the start.

label: Paired anxiety-specific measures recorded (%)
help: Percentage of people with an anxiety disorder who had an appropriate anxiety-specific measure recorded at first and last appointment.

label: Paired anxiety-specific measures recorded (number)
help: Number of people with an appropriate paired anxiety-disorder-specific measure (ADSM).

label: Finished treatment needing an anxiety-specific measure
help: Number of people finishing treatment for whom an anxiety-disorder-specific measure (ADSM) applies.
